question: Can a fixed longer prefix-identical execution of the same two seeded trajectories meet the unchanged conditional sampler diagnostics?
contract_reason: The original no_retry_rule forbids extra chains, changed seeds, wider criteria and outcome-tuned priors. This separately prespecified fixed-length sampler-accuracy qualification changes none of those. It does not rewrite, relabel or erase the failed 8000-state experiment, nor claim a new independent replicate. The old prefixes are shared states, not additional draws.
same_target_and_runtime: Use the identical original protocol data, likelihood rows, priors, initial top-age pairs, seeds, calibration files, native executable input programs (excluding only the recognized first source-generated ## Ran on timestamp comment), shared native library and fixed-transition save clock. Do not use rounded .last endpoints as .init restarts.
prefix_rule: Each new native byte stream must begin with the entire original 5678254 bytes, including the leading blank line and absent trailing newline, then the next byte must be a newline starting the next saved state. No numeric tolerance, row reformatting, rounded comparison or prefix state duplication is allowed.
qualification_gate: Both exact prefixes, every original age/memory/free-parameter/energy diagnostic, independent age integration and resource checks must pass. coda Gelman upper95 must remain <1.05 and combinedESS>=400, autoburninFALSE, transformFALSE, all107ages and original free axes. Do not call the frozen score consumer before prefix and diagnostic qualification. A failure retains raw outputs and explicit unscored status; no new score interpretation or further extension follows.

resources.handling: Existing bounded executor supplies the 600-second native command deadline; measure native peakRSS and refuse on missing/excess measurement. Check actual output bytes after execution, preserve failed files; no operating-system memory/filesystem quota is claimed.

storage_estimate.basis: Native rows grow by 19501/7501; retained age/score exports grow fourfold. Original compression is a planning estimate, not a guaranteed size. The 100 MB ceiling provides about 56 percent headroom over this 64 MB estimate.

exposure: Already exposed development core, frozen predictors and previously computed failed-run scores. This is numerical accuracy work on the same conditional chronology, not untouched validation or a new ecological model. Score interpretation is withheld until qualification.

native_program_comparison.rule: Preserve both full input files. Require first line to start ## Ran on and compare every byte after its terminating newline exactly; no other comment, whitespace, label, calibration or model token is normalized.
native_program_comparison.source_semantics: Unmodified rbacon 4.0.2 src/input.cpp, lines 93–100 skips leading spaces then ignores any line beginning # or newline before key parsing/calibration/determinations/initialization. The narrower first-header exclusion changes no sampler instructions or RNG state.
native_program_comparison.preparation_failure: The first committed invocation stopped before sampling because full native input bytes differed only in that generated timestamp. Its native output is 0 B and fit-summary has no completed chain. Failed directory/logs retained; no sampler result or diagnostic failure was retried.
